description: GOV-400 package notice-coverage rule set, shared by cmake/ValidateStagedPackageNotices.cmake (staged-package gate) and tools/governance/generate_third_party_notices.py (--check-package and the repository font inventory). Every font file in a package, and every font a shipped binary embeds (embeddedFonts), must be named on a 'Files:' line of a THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt inventory entry whose notice files are reproduced with license text. Every file matching a payload rule must map to an inventory entry with license text, or carry a documented first-party exemption; a file matching a 'systemRuntime' rule must be named on the 'Files:' line of that inventory entry, which must carry a 'Terms:' line (the vendor's redistribution terms are not a file in the repository); a file under a third-party root that no rule maps is uncovered. Closed-world classification (SPARK_PACKAGE_NOTICE_CLASSIFICATION=closed, --closed-world) additionally requires every other file to be listed with an identified license in a matching 'assetManifests' manifest, or to match a justified 'firstPartyRoots' pattern; anything else is unclassified. A file matching a 'noticeText' rule (a shipped license text) must be named on the 'Notice files:' line of an inventory entry whose texts are reproduced. The optional installComponents list identifies which CMake install components can carry each payload rule; it scopes only dependency-presence requirements after an MSI proves its exact feature graph against the committed package profile. It never removes notice coverage for a shipped file. An omitted installComponents list applies to every profile. Patterns are regular expressions over the package-relative path with '/' separators, limited to the syntax CMake and Python share (literals, escaped dots, bracket classes, groups with alternation, ? * + ^ $).

licenseText.operativeTermsPattern: Permission is (hereby )?granted|Permission to use, copy, modify|Redistribution and use|public domain|TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR USE

embeddedFonts.description: Fonts that third-party code compiles into binaries (ThirdParty/Licenses/embedded-fonts.json keys, which must equal 'markers'). Each marker is the name the embedding code compiles into every binary that carries the font. A package file matching 'scanPattern' that contains a marker must have the marker named on a 'Files:' line of an inventory entry whose notice files are reproduced with license text. Files larger than 'maximumScanBytes' fail closed rather than going unscanned.

payloadRules.firstParty: Installed from ThirdParty/Scripting/patches, which ThirdParty/supply-chain.lock records as first-party integration headers.

payloadRules.noticeText: Upstream license texts of the editor fonts, installed with the fonts from SparkEditor/Fonts/LICENSES (SparkEditor/CMakeLists.txt)

assetManifests.justification: The runtime asset tree ships with its RDY-020 integrity manifest (cmake/SparkRuntimeAssets.cmake), which records an SPDX license and provenance for every file; a file it does not list, or lists as NOASSERTION, has no identified license.

firstPartyRoots.justification: The repository LICENSE and the notice file generated by cmake/SparkThirdPartyAudit.cmake.
